78203.subject: Passage is now integrated with Ondo
78203.body:
Ondo joins Superstate in the Passage catalogue, adding 400+ tokenized products

( https://docs.passage.coinlist.co/assets/partners/ondo?utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=passage_ondo_launch_2026_08&utm_content=banner_image )

*Passage is now integrated with Ondo Stocks*

Passage now supports *Ondo Stocks* ( https://docs.passage.coinlist.co/assets/partners/ondo?utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=passage_ondo_launch_2026_08&utm_content=inline_link ) , adding 400+ tokenized products to the catalogue available through a single SDK integration. It is the largest single expansion of the Passage catalogue to date, and it opens up asset classes that have been out of reach for most platforms offering tokenized exposure.

Tokenized asset offerings have generally meant a short list of large-cap US names or a single treasury product. Ondo Stocks brings individual equities across sectors, ETFs and index products, and commodities into one catalogue. That range is what allows a partner to build an actual investing experience rather than a novelty feature: diversified portfolios, sector exposure, broad market index positions, and non-correlated assets alongside equities.

For a fintech, neobank, or wallet, the practical effect is that catalogue depth is no longer the constraint on what you can build. One integration gives your users access to hundreds of products across multiple asset classes, natively inside your own product, with no separate work required per issuer or per asset type.

Ondo joins Superstate in the Passage catalogue, with more platforms to follow. Fintechs, neobanks, and wallet providers interested in offering tokenized assets to their users can get in touch below.

GET IN TOUCH ( https://airtable.com/appAjHhqZC9FIPEuR/pagRl25Yb4UNpremc/form?prefill_utm_source=newsletter&hide_utm_source=true&prefill_utm_medium=email&hide_utm_medium=true&prefill_utm_campaign=passage_ondo_launch_2026_08&hide_utm_campaign=true&prefill_utm_content=launch_send&hide_utm_content=true )

77664.subject: Online check-in for a smooth take-off. ATTENTION! Don’t forget – it opens 24 hours before departure. (Y9SB5U)
77664.body:
Hello, Oleh Novosadov!

Your adventure is just around the corner – you’ll soon be boarding your Ryanair flight! There’s just one small step left to ensure a smooth start: online check-in.

It’s easy – do it via the Ryanair app. This way, you avoid unnecessary fees at the airport..

How to do it? Here’s a quick guide:

You will need:
- Booking code: Y9SB5U
- Booking email: novosadov@boarding.sk (it may differ from your personal email address)

If you’re using the Ryanair mobile app, you can check in directly there – it’s fast, convenient and eco-friendly.

When is check-in available?
- From 24 to 2 hours before departure
- If you’ve purchased seats, you can check in as early as 60 days before your flight

Download your boarding passes.

Save them in the app – you’ll need them when going through airport security. Before your trip, make sure your BOARDING PASSES (tickets) are in ELECTRONIC FORM. Download them to your phone.

You’ll find a full step-by-step guide with screenshots in our manual for checking in online via the Ryanair app.

ATTENTION! If you leave the check-in until the airport, it may cost you up to €55.

That’s a lot of money you could use for your next Pelikan adventure instead! Check our calendar of promotional flights and start planning your next trip right now!

Yours faithfully
